Name: Cute Chest Buckles - Sweet Hearts or Witchy Moons
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
This mod is pretty straightforward, it changes the chest buckles to a heart or a moon.

This works with 1.6! It includes the wooden chests, big wooden chests, stone chests, and big stone chests.

This is a retake/addition to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10364]Cuter Chests[/url] mod by fieldonfire, thanks to him for letting me do this!

Just download the zip file and extract the mod into your mods folder. Once you start up the game, you can change which shape you want in the config.json or GMCM. Each type of chest can be changed to heart or moon, default being heart.

Downloads.Description: Now includes stone chests! Also fixed the moon chests to be less clunky looking. Added update keys to manifest
